run_cifar_training: run a CIFAR training loop with a ResNet18 model using SGD optimizer and distributed data parallel
build_model_with_quantizer: build a MobileNet model with DiffQuantizer for differentiable quantization-aware training on CIFAR
configure_optimizer: configure an AdamW optimizer with weight decay and custom beta2 for model training
setup_data_loaders: setup distributed training and test data loaders with configurable batch size and num workers
train_with_lsq_quantization: train a ResNet20 model using LSQ quantization with specified bit width and min size
